boundary: No hidden World files, complete Tonmick outcomes or reveal inputs used
censoring_link: Within each declared group, uncensored at-risk histories represent the unavailable subsequent event histories, with sufficient follow-up support. Not established from these data. No independence of event types assumed.
clock: exact recorded decimal text; at most three decimals, no jitter/unrounding
event_of_interest: withdrawal before transfer by month12 under actual mixed policy
finite_target: AJ is an assumption-dependent plug-in candidate for the finite roster, not its exact identified fraction
prior_knowledge: Supplied handoff numerical anchors, observed counts, policy and previous units known before this rebuilt freeze; not blind preregistration. Earlier Unit10 files not recovered; no retrospective pooled-spec amendment invented.
standardization: original invitation shares, separately fitted observation-policy groups
tie_rule: pre-exit risk set including tied censors; both event increments use preceding event-free mass; then remove all tied exits
uncertainty: logical binary-support bounds only; no confidence interval or causal no-transfer interpretation
